title: How to play
summary: The in-game guide; each part opens the first time you reach it (first battle, first trait choice, first inventory expansion, first visit to Upgrade).

pages.title: FIGHT! ARK RANGER!
pages.text:
■ FIGHT! ARK RANGER is a mini game where you merge and upgrade weapons to stop incoming monsters.
■ Strategically upgrade your Ark Machine using the shop that appears after each wave ends, or by selecting traits when leveling up.
■ Combat proceeds automatically, save for the use of your Burst Skill.

pages.title: FIGHT! ARK RANGER!
pages.text:
Waves and Monsters

■ Monsters come in waves, and you must survive a total of 100 waves.
■ Monsters are divided into minions, elites, and bosses. Elites and bosses appear in specific waves.
■ Some minions and elites are special monsters that can use skills.

pages.title: The Shop
pages.text:
Shop Overview

■ The shop opens after each wave ends.
■ It consists of two sections: Inventory and Weapons.
■ While in the shop, you can manage your inventory as well as remove weapons that you don't want to use from the weapon pool.
■ Drag and drop weapons from the Weapons section into your inventory to equip them.
■ Weapons in you inventory will be used in battles.
■ The Weapons section features new weapons each time the shop opens, and can also be used to store weapons temporarily.
■ All weapons left in the Weapons section will disappear when the next wave begins.

pages.title: The Shop
pages.text:
Managing Your Inventory

■ Weapons can be freely moved between your inventory and the Weapons section, as long as they fit within your inventory.
■ Stacking weapons of the same type and rarity will merge them. Merging increases the weapon's rarity and improves its performance.
■ Weapons can be merged in both your inventory and the Weapons section.

pages.title: The Shop
pages.text:
Weapon Types

■ There are two types of weapons: main weapons and sub-weapons.
■ Tap a weapon's icon to view its info.
■ Main weapons attack at regular intervals, dealing damage to monsters.
■ Each main weapon has a tag that determines the traits that apply to that weapon.
■ Sub-weapons do not attack directly, but they provide buffs that are useful in battle.

pages.title: The Shop
pages.text:
Rotating Weapons

■ You can use the weapon rotation feature to rotate weapons. 
■ Weapons can be equipped in a rotated orientation. 
■ On mobile, select a weapon and then tap it again to rotate it.
■ On PC, select a weapon and then right-click or tap the R key to rotate it.

pages.title: The Shop
pages.text:
Refreshing and Removing Weapons

■ You can refresh the Weapons section to replace the current lineup with a fixed number of new weapons.
■ Once all free refreshes are used, refreshing will cost gold.
■ You can also remove unwanted weapons. Removed weapons will no longer appear in the Weapons section.

pages.title: Selecting Traits
pages.text:
Selecting Traits

■ Defeating monsters grants EXP. You'll level up once you earn a certain amount of EXP.
■ When leveling up, you can choose between traits that provide different effects.
■ Traits are divided into three tiers: I, II, and III. As you level up, higher tier traits may appear.
■ By default, you will have three traits to choose from each time, but you can get an additional option via an upgrade.
■ You can acquire more than one copy of the same ordinary trait, but unique traits can only be obtained once per game.

pages.title: Selecting Traits
pages.text:
Refreshing Traits

■ To refresh traits, tap the Refresh button.
■ Refreshing will clear the displayed trait list and generate a new one.
■ Once all refreshes are used, you won't be able to refresh the trait list anymore.

pages.title: Expanding Your Inventory
pages.text:
Expanding Your Inventory

■ You can expand your inventory after clearing specific waves.
■ To do so, tap the slots you want to add to your inventory, then tap the Complete Expansion button to confirm.
■ You cannot proceed to the next wave until all Inventory Expansion Points are used.
■ Weapons can be placed in the newly opened slots.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text:
Upgrades

■ Defeat monsters to earn gold, which can be used to acquire useful skills for your Ark Machines.
■ Use the Reset button to get back spent gold and reset your skill levels.
